question:
Let \(a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_{100}\) be real numbers, each less than one, satisfy
\[
a_1+a_2+\cdots+a_{100}>1.
\]
(i) Let \(n_0\) be the smallest integer \(n\) such that
\[
a_1+a_2+\cdots+a_n>1.
\]
Show that all the sums \(a_{n_0},\ a_{n_0}+a_{n_0-1},\ldots,a_{n_0}+\cdots+a_1\) are positive.

(ii) Show that there exist two integers \(p\) and \(q\), \(p<q\), such that the numbers
\[
a_q,\ a_q+a_{q-1},\ldots,a_q+\cdots+a_p,
\]
\[
a_p,\ a_p+a_{p+1},\ldots,a_p+\cdots+a_q
\]
are all positive.
